intent: Report the mean read depth of each exon listed in exons.bed, so that exons of different length can be ranked by how deeply they are covered.
silent_error: samtools bedcov reports, per BED interval, the sum of the per-base depths (total aligned bases), not the mean depth. With intervals of different length the numbers are not comparable: here exon_a (100 bp, mean depth 3) and exon_b (300 bp, mean depth 1) both come out as 300, and exon_c (50 bp, mean depth 2) as 100, which inverts the ranking. The column looks like a coverage value and nothing in the output says it is a sum; the one-line description of the subcommand is 'read depth per BED region', and only the manual page states that the value is the sum of per-base depths.
